title: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform market data
geography: European bidding zones; exact dataset/zone coverage varies
format: XML REST API; portal downloads
access: Registered API token for authenticated extraction; reuse existing entsoe-py dependency, no credentials created here
license_or_terms: Reuse terms and reusable-data list are dataset-specific; exchange-origin rights cannot be assumed open
cadence: Market interval; revisions and publication timestamps
limitations: Historical market observations are not forecasts. SDAC transitioned to 15-minute MTU in Oct 2025; preserve interval and bidding zone. Inspect current per-dataset reuse list before common redistribution.
integration_mode: Versioned price_series import, rights-gated common seed or private/org fetch; source pin and raw resolution

title: SMARD downloadable market data
geography: Germany and displayed neighboring market areas; validate dataset geography
format: CSV downloads; documented portal exports
access: Free public downloads; UI supports up to two years per file
license_or_terms: CC BY 4.0 for Market data visuals/download data; required source attribution Bundesnetzagentur | SMARD.de
cadence: Market interval and revised historical publication
limitations: Do not infer all website material or all exchange data everywhere has the same rights. Preserve temporal resolution, timezone and data quality/revision.
integration_mode: Small attributed Germany price seed and scheduled validated series import

title: Energinet Energi Data Service DayAheadPrices and price catalog
geography: DK1/DK2 and available neighboring PriceArea values; schema-specific
format: Public JSON API; CSV/export; per-dataset catalog
access: Public API without key; two bounded limit=1 queries succeeded in this research
license_or_terms: Published Energi Data Service data CC BY 4.0; credit and modifications required
cadence: Market interval; selected datasets update daily or faster
limitations: Real query confirmed current DayAheadPrices fields TimeUTC/TimeDK/DayAheadPriceEUR/DKK versus legacy Elspotprices HourUTC/HourDK/SpotPriceEUR/DKK ending Sep 2025 in returned latest row. Do not assume legacy hourly schema remains current.
integration_mode: Pinned schema/resolution-aware price_series connector; optional Danish tariff series after rate applicability checks

title: Elexon Insights Solution datasets
geography: Great Britain settlement and balancing system
format: Public REST JSON/CSV/XML; OpenAPI
access: Official developer portal states public APIs and no API key required
license_or_terms: BSC licences vary by identified dataset; Open/Public/Shared classifications exist. Exact BMRS/Open Data licence applicability must be checked
cadence: Settlement period and publication/revision times
limitations: Imbalance price or Market Index Data is not universally the day-ahead auction price. Some licence pages returned 403 to this research client; retain as pending dataset-level terms review.
integration_mode: Dataset-specific GB series connector with settlement semantics and rights metadata

title: NESO TNUoS and related charging datasets
geography: Great Britain transmission tariff zones and classes
format: CSV downloads and public CKAN-compatible API; charging reports
access: Public data portal; sign-in needed for subscriptions rather than basic listed CSV
license_or_terms: Dataset page links NESO Open Data Licence; commercial reuse with specified attribution and exceptions
cadence: Quarterly publication updates; annual tariff years and forecasts
limitations: Separate forecast/provisional/final records and generator versus demand schedules. Tariff year often April-March; a label 2026 may mean 2025/26 in a particular resource. This is not DUoS or a complete retail bill.
integration_mode: Typed tariff/connection_agreement extracts; resource and forecast-status pins; independent charge fixtures

title: 50Hertz transmission grid-access price sheets
geography: German transmission-grid access in 50Hertz area
format: Annual PDF price sheets and standard-contract attachments
access: Public direct documents; 2026 sheet explicitly valid Jan 1-Dec 31 2026
license_or_terms: Publicly accessible; no broad redistribution licence verified for the selected sheet
cadence: Annual, with possible in-year legal/regulatory revision
limitations: Annual-use hours, voltage and power/energy class matter. Not the DSO final customer tariff; statutory levies/taxes and connection fees separate. Publication is not a legal reuse grant.
integration_mode: Official-source bounded fetch; reviewed tariff extract with valid dates/page spans; common promotion only after terms review

title: Netze BW distribution price sheets and electronic tariff workbook
geography: Netze BW distribution service territory, Germany
format: PDF plus electronic XLS price sheet and XLS charge calculator
access: Public final 2026 documents alongside provisional 2027 documents
license_or_terms: Public access; redistribution terms for workbook/document not verified
cadence: Annual with revised/provisional issue state
limitations: Do not select provisional 2027 just because it is latest. Voltage/metering/use-hours classes and levies differ. Upstream network costs may already be included; avoid stacking TSO and DSO terms twice.
integration_mode: Pilot structured tariff parser against final XLS/PDF and official worked calculator; store only admitted terms

title: Liander large-business connection and transport tariffs
geography: Liander service area, Netherlands
format: Annual PDF price sheets; public large-business tariffs
access: Public standard tariff sheets; tailored customer information can require Mijn Liander
license_or_terms: Provider website/contract terms; common-library redistribution not established
cadence: Annual and agreement-specific revisions
limitations: Separate recurring transport and one-off connection costs, contracted kW versus monthly peak versus energy, producer/consumer and voltage class. Availability/congestion and customer terms cannot be inferred from standard rate.
integration_mode: Reviewed tariff and connection_agreement items; retain exact operator/customer applicability

title: ACM TenneT 2026 transmission tariff decision
publisher: Netherlands Authority for Consumers and Markets
geography: TenneT Netherlands HS/EHS connection classes
format: Regulator decision and attachments
access: Public regulator publication; 2026 tariffs apply from Jan 1 for stated voltage classes
license_or_terms: Regulatory publication; selected attachment reuse terms still to record
cadence: Annual regulator decisions with legal revision
limitations: Decision distinguishes 110/150 kV and 220/380 kV. Does not substitute for Liander or another DSO tariff. Maximum approved tariffs and user actual contract may differ.
integration_mode: Authoritative dated reference for TenneT tariff items; cross-check operator sheet and applicable voltage

title: CRE TURPE 7 current tariff decisions and calculator
publisher: Commission de Regulation de l Energie
geography: France HTB transmission and HTA/BT distribution
format: Decisions/PDF and official indicative calculator at https://calculatrice.cre.fr/
access: Public decisions and calculator; 2026 update links the May 21 decisions
license_or_terms: Selected decision/document reuse terms require verification; no blanket website licence inferred
cadence: TURPE framework plus annual Aug 1 changes and applicable corrections
limitations: TURPE7 initial Aug 2025 values are not the current Aug 2026 coefficients. Distribution includes upstream transport: do not add both. Calculator covers TURPE only, excluding supply and taxes; output indicative.
integration_mode: Dated tariff extracts with HTB vs HTA/BT and subscribed-power/time-band rules; bill oracle fixture on supported subset

title: CNMC 2026 electricity transport/distribution access tolls
publisher: Comision Nacional de los Mercados y la Competencia
geography: Spain voltage and access-tariff classes
format: Resolution PDF; assignment model XLSX; BOE legal publication
access: Public regulator package for exercise 2026
license_or_terms: Public legal/regulator data; selected document/database reuse conditions not fully verified
cadence: Annual tolls; tariff calendars and regulatory amendments
limitations: Peajes are not all bill charges: separate government cargos, supplier commodity and tax. Six-period calendars, voltage, contracted power, excess power and reactive terms need native mapping; unmapped terms refused.
integration_mode: Regulator-pinned Spanish tariff schema and calendar; independent known-bill reference before promotion

title: e-distribuzione ARERA transport and system components
geography: Italy applicable distribution/measurement/transmission customer classes
format: HTML tables/downloads and cited ARERA decisions
access: Public current-tariff page citing 2026 decisions
license_or_terms: Public operator/regulator information; selected extraction/common reuse terms require review
cadence: Annual transport tariffs plus quarterly system-component changes
limitations: Page says transport only; commodity and fiscal charges excluded. Distinguish power/energy/fixed charges, voltage class, energy-intensive relief eligibility and quarterly system charges.
integration_mode: Version tariff rows by component/effective date; prevent duplicate transmission and excluded tax/full-bill claims

title: Statnett transmission tariffs
geography: Norway transmission-connected generation and demand
format: Public tables and annual tariff/methodology documents
access: Public annual schedules and explanatory material
license_or_terms: Public access; selected tables redistributability not verified
cadence: Annual with model/regulatory revisions
limitations: Norwegian NOK, loss factors and producer/demand terms differ; not a generic Nordic DSO bill. Upcoming model and published future-year tariff need effective-date/status separation.
integration_mode: Norway transmission tariff item and methodology, bounded scope and unit/FX basis

title: Swissgrid transmission grid and system-service tariffs
geography: Switzerland transmission charges; downstream pass-through depends on network level
format: Public year-comparison HTML tables and downloads
access: Public current and future year tables
license_or_terms: Public website information; selected table/document reuse terms not verified
cadence: Annual
limitations: Do not confuse 2027/2026 columns. Usage/system-service/power-reserve and new solidarised costs are distinct; downstream utility may already include these. CHF/Rp vs currency/kWh conversion explicit.
integration_mode: Typed Swiss transmission/surcharge references; valid-year and network-level applicability

title: ElCom Swiss electricity-price portal and CSV
geography: Swiss municipalities, network operators and standard customer categories
format: CSV/download portal and opendata.swiss-linked resources
access: Public portal; JS rendering limits inspection; verify chosen downloadable resource
license_or_terms: Dataset-specific Swiss terms to inspect; no blanket redistribution approval from portal visibility
cadence: Annual tariff collection
limitations: Standard customer-category annual comparisons are not negotiated industrial procurement terms; commodity/network/levies must remain separable. Portal availability was checked, exact CSV/API resource not exercised here.
integration_mode: Geographic benchmark/reference and later typed tariff extraction after selected resource validation

title: UK Contracts for Difference Allocation Round results
publisher: UK Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
geography: Great Britain awarded CfD projects/technologies
format: Accessible HTML tables and PDF
access: Public government publication
license_or_terms: Open Government Licence v3.0 except identified third-party rights, explicitly stated on publication
cadence: Allocation rounds and corrections
limitations: Auction award benchmark, not corporate PPA quote or executable deal. AR7 displays both 2012 and 2024 money bases; retain indexation, technology, delivery and round.
integration_mode: Attributed contract/reference-range item; user selects actual price and terms; no automatic market quote

title: ACER PPA market monitoring and publicly listed contract templates
geography: EU and country PPA market structures
format: HTML; country-sheet/report PDF; linked third-party legal templates
access: Public overview and linked annual reports/templates
license_or_terms: ACER and linked third-party report/template rights differ; source underlying-data rights not established
cadence: Annual monitoring and template updates
limitations: Not transaction-level current prices. Industry data may be third-party; no blanket embedding of linked EFET/DENA/ISDA legal text. Use to qualify illustrative archetypes and user-supplied offers.
integration_mode: Evidence-linked PPA contract archetypes/ranges, not a price feed; third-party template links kept as references

title: European Hydrogen Bank IF25 auction results
geography: Selected EEA hydrogen-production projects
format: HTML project tables and official call/results documents
access: Public commission publication
license_or_terms: EU-owned website content CC BY 4.0 unless otherwise stated; third-party exceptions
cadence: Auction rounds; invited/signed/withdrawn status changes
limitations: EUR/kg bid is support premium for verified eligible output, not total H2 production cost or market sale price. Some results invited to grant preparation; not signed or operational.
integration_mode: Reference-only subsidy/contract assumption with status/date, never hydrogen commodity price

title: Eurostat non-household electricity/gas prices and components
geography: EU/EFTA and other reported geography, subject to country-specific reuse exceptions
format: SDMX/statistics JSON/TSV and data browser; nrg_pc_205, nrg_pc_205_c, nrg_pc_203
access: Public statistical data; no customer contract access
license_or_terms: Commercial statistical reuse with attribution under EC policy, with geography/source exceptions
cadence: Semiannual energy prices; annual component data
limitations: Consumption-band averages, not site tariff/15-minute marginal price. Third-party data and countries outside EU/EFTA/candidate groups can be excluded from commercial reuse. Tax categories/currency/PPS are distinct.
integration_mode: Benchmarks/QA ranges with country/band/tax metadata; no substitution for actual tariff

title: European Commission Weekly Oil Bulletin
geography: EU countries and petroleum product categories
format: XLSX current prices with/without tax; historical workbook and methodology
access: Public weekly files; no API subscription required for downloads
license_or_terms: EU-owned data reuse under EC CC BY 4.0 policy unless otherwise indicated; third-party content excluded
cadence: Weekly; history from 2005 in listed workbook
limitations: Consumer petroleum benchmark, not delivered bulk genset fuel quote or guaranteed off-road exemption. Country methodology/product/unit/tax treatment explicit; convert to energy only with declared density/LHV.
integration_mode: Attributed fuel-price/levy reference; user-reviewed delivered-fuel adjustment separate

title: EEX EU ETS1 primary auction results
geography: EU ETS1 auction allowances/products
format: Public auction reports/history ZIP; licensed market-data products separately
access: Public report access; automated redistribution/product use rights must be checked
license_or_terms: Exchange licensing conditions and product-specific terms; no open licence inferred
cadence: Auction days with corrected reports/history
limitations: Primary auction clearing price is not spot/futures curve or a universal carbon tax. No scrape/redistribution of proprietary futures/GO/gas/PPA index feeds without rights. ETS1/ETS2/UK ETS must not be mixed.
integration_mode: Rights-reviewed reference import or BYO licensed series; no unrestricted common feed

title: Enedis services/connection prestations catalogue
geography: Enedis distribution service territory, France
format: Public HTML catalogue and referenced tariff/legal documents
access: Public catalogue, but JS limits inspection; official indexed text signals restricted reuse
license_or_terms: Official indexed terms warn against reuse beyond stated purpose; full exact conditions require review before any import
cadence: Catalogue and regulatory revisions
limitations: Publicly readable is not open data. Do not ship copied catalogue text/table or build common cost library from it without appropriate right. Regulated tariff decisions may be a different source/rights path.
integration_mode: Link/reference or authorized customer-provided extract only until rights established
